## Antilatency Pillars

The brand new tracking area
[Antilatency Pillars]

# Antilatency is an inside-out tracking system provider for VR/AR, Virtual Production, MoCap, Drones
# and Robotics that enables an unlimited multiuser experience within the tracking area without
# restrictions on scale or shape.

[
VR|AR
][24]
[
OEM
][25]
[
Robotics
][26]
[
Virtual Production
][27]

## Technology

Drawing on 15 years of expertise, our team has crafted a tracking system using our own advanced
technologies, ensuring unmatched precision and adaptability for various needs.
**Sensor Fusion**
IMU-based tracking with real-time corrections from optical data, minimizing occlusions.
**Latency Compensation**
Achieves up to 2000 measurements per second with a mere 2ms hardware latency.
**Unlimited tracking targets**
Native Multitarget Mode, enhancing occlusion management.
**Onboard Processing**
Main data processing is handled by the tracker, optimizing performance.
**Hardware Agnostic**
Designed for compatibility with a  wide range of devices, ensuring flexibility and integration ease
across different hardware setups.
**Scalable Area**
Expandable to 100x100m, catering to diverse needs.
[
LEARN MORE ABOUT TECH
][28]

## VR | AR

Antilatency excels in VR projects like LBE, VR training, and immersive experiences, featuring high
precision and 6DoF for dynamic, large-scale multi-user environments.
[
LEARN MORE
][29]
[
CONTACT SALES
][30]
Andy Higgs
Sales Director, AVRT — Adaptive Virtual Reality Training
The AVRT system uses the Antilatency positional tracking system for the external tracking of
weapons, headsets and other items in our fully-immersive, free-roam VR simulation system.
Antilatency gives us a warehouse-scale tracking solution in a fully portable and scalable solution,
allowing us to turn any venue into a training venue, quickly and easily.
[Andy Higgs]

## Virtual Production

Antilatency enhances Virtual Production with its advanced tracking for cameras, actors, and props,
supporting both wired and wireless setups in green screen and LED settings. It integrates seamlessly
with popular software, optimizing virtual production workflows.
[
LEARN MORE
][31]
[
CONTACT SALES
][32]
Richard Frantzén
Tech and Creative Lead, Virtual Star Studios
Virtual events and productions are relying on a lot of different technology. When offering services
to leading brands we have to produce undeniable results and all parameters have to be on point.
Antilatency has always been a solid link in our virtual production chain.
[Richard Frantzén]

## CyberGaffer

A brand-new approach to lighting in virtual production: CyberGaffer uses advanced mathematical
calculations and calibration techniques to provide the most precise real-world approximation of
virtual scene lighting in a physical studio.
[
LEARN MORE
][33]
Ramiro Montes De Oca
Virtual Production Manager at KINO FLO
When I say that CyberGaffer is on another level, it's not an understatement. The technique was
there, but CyberGaffer is going to become the new standard. Most work involving Unreal Engine and
image-based lighting isn't straightforward, but CyberGaffer changes that — and taking that workflow
outside of Unreal Engine is another challenge they've solved with HDRi images. They're not only
bringing physics into the equation, but also simplifying setups.
We are planning to offer training on the system and incorporate more products into this lineup.
[Andy Higgs]

## OEM

Antilatency's OEM solutions offer a seamless integration pathway for embedding advanced tracking
capabilities into hardware products. Tailored for versatility and adaptability, our technology
enhances the value of hardware across various industries
[
CONTACT SALES
][34]

## Robotics

Antilatency's technology revolutionizes robotics by providing high-precision, low-latency tracking
solutions. Ideal for navigation, interaction, and complex task execution, our system enhances
robotic applications with unparalleled spatial awareness and accuracy.
[
CONTACT SALES
][35]

## Antilatency Developers

[
LEARN MORE
][36]
The Antilatency Developers portal is a comprehensive hub for developers, offering crucial technical
information, software, and tutorials on the Antilatency system, including an innovative SDK
configurator.

# A Leader in the Discovery and Development of First- and Best-in-class Small Molecule Cancer
# Therapies

Ascentage Pharma is an integrated global biopharmaceutical company engaged in discovering,
developing and commercializing both first- and best-in-class therapies to address global unmet
medical needs. For more than two decades, our founders and team have leveraged their deep expertise
to develop our proprietary drug discovery platform to pursue particularly challenging targets. We
are the only company in the world with active clinical programs targeting all three known classes of
key apoptosis regulators that restore programmed cell death. Our clinical candidates include novel
Bcl-2 and Bcl-2/Bcl-xL inhibitors, as well as candidates aimed at IAP and MDM2-p53 pathways, and
next-generation tyrosine kinase inhibitors (TKIs). We have eleven completed or ongoing international
registrational trials, including two that are FDA-regulated.

## Ascentage is bringing innovative therapies to patients across the world for cancers and other
## diseases, using expertise in compounds that affect programmed cell death.

continually looking to identify partners with portfolios that are complementary to the specific
mechanisms of action of our therapeutic candidates.

### Check out our latest product releases.

###### see what's new

#### One asset. Real-time to final frame.

##### V-Ray 7, update 4 for Media & Entertainment is here.
##### 
##### Access final-frame quality, real-time rendering right in your DCC’s viewport. Ensure your
##### scenes are virtual production-ready, allowing you to access real-time on LED walls in minutes
##### and take instant creative control to achieve perfect cinematic realism. Seamlessly match
##### real-world scans to your scene lighting with Gaussian Splat relighting, and reach final frames
##### faster with boosted CPU and GPU performance, artist-friendly workflows, and a renderer that’s
##### ready for any pipeline.

[Learn more][106]

###### [The 2026 V-Ray VFX & Animation Showreel is here][107]

We are proud to present this year's showreel, showcasing extraordinary work from film VFX to intense
game cinematics, feature animations, and more. This is a celebration of our community’s immense
talent and the passion brought to every production, continually pushing the boundaries of what is
possible with V-Ray. We’re honored to be part of your creative journey!

[Watch the showreel >][108]

[
][109]

###### [V-Ray 7, update 4 out now for SketchUp, Rhino, and 3ds Max][110]

V-Ray 7, Update 4 brings instant AI ideation, enhancement, image-to-video generation, and more via a
new integration with Veras. From real-time rendering in the V-Ray viewport to AI-powered tools,
enhanced realism with Quick Caustics and Parallax Interiors, and integrated collaboration—everything
works together in one proven pipeline.

[Learn more >][111]

[
][112]

###### [Veras 4.5: More control. Less friction][113]

Veras 4.5 is here, giving you finer, better control over your renders. Smart selection lets you
click any object, material, or space in your render to instantly isolate and edit it - no mask
painting. This release also adds shareable gallery links, background removal for transparent PNG
exports, upload history navigation, updated sketching tools and more.

[Learn more >][114]

###### [Corona 15: More power for artists. Same simplicity.][115]

Corona has always made stunning photoreal rendering feel simple. With Corona 15, that experience
gets even better, bringing more of what you need directly into your workflow. AI-powered ideation
with Veras is now built in, giving you the freedom to explore ideas and go from still to animation
instantly. Everything in your connected ecosystem works together more smoothly - so you can focus on
creating, collaborate easily, and deliver incredible results faster, all with full artistic control.

[Learn more >][116]

##### Access final-frame quality, real-time rendering right in your DCC’s viewport. Ensure your

###### [V-Ray 7, update 4 out now for SketchUp, Rhino, and 3ds Max][110]

V-Ray 7, Update 4 brings instant AI ideation, enhancement, image-to-video generation, and more via a
new integration with Veras. From real-time rendering in the V-Ray viewport to AI-powered tools,
enhanced realism with Quick Caustics and Parallax Interiors, and integrated collaboration—everything
works together in one proven pipeline.

[Learn more >][111]

###### [Veras 4.5: More control. Less friction][113]

Veras 4.5 is here, giving you finer, better control over your renders. Smart selection lets you
click any object, material, or space in your render to instantly isolate and edit it - no mask
painting. This release also adds shareable gallery links, background removal for transparent PNG
exports, upload history navigation, updated sketching tools and more.

[Learn more >][114]

###### [Corona 15: More power for artists. Same simplicity.][115]

Corona has always made stunning photoreal rendering feel simple. With Corona 15, that experience
gets even better, bringing more of what you need directly into your workflow. AI-powered ideation
with Veras is now built in, giving you the freedom to explore ideas and go from still to animation
instantly. Everything in your connected ecosystem works together more smoothly - so you can focus on
creating, collaborate easily, and deliver incredible results faster, all with full artistic control.

[RGV Web.jpg]

### Ram Gopal Varma

Film Maker

Ram Gopal Varma is an Indian film director, screenwriter, and producer, primarily known for his work
in Hindi and Telugu films. Varma has directed films across multiple genres. He made an entry into
Telugu cinema with the path breaking crime thriller Siva (1989), Best First Film of a Director, and
the Filmfare Award for Best Film.

[IMK.jpg]

### Mohana Krishna Indrakanti

Director

Mohana Krishna Indraganti is an Indian director known for his works predominantly in Telugu cinema.
His debut directorial venture Grahanam (2005) fetched him eleven awards including the National Film
Award for Best First Film of a Director

[Sandeep Reddy Vanga.jpg]

Film Maker

Sandeep Reddy Vanga is an Indian filmmaker, screenwriter, and editor known for his works in Telugu
and Hindi cinema. Vanga made his screenwriting and directing debut with the 2017 Telugu-language
romantic drama film Arjun Reddy. It was a critical and commercial success

# Free AI 3D Rendering & Visualization Software

Your Flow. Unbroken.

An ecosystem that evolves with your design — bridging AI and precise 3D control to carry every
decision forward, from first sketch to final delivery.

[ Download Free ][58]

Free for individuals · Pro plans from $38/month

[Companies using D5]
Active Professionals
3 M+
Design Firms
50 K+
Rendering Software on G2
No. 1

But every workflow today is full of breaks.

## The Disconnect.

Design is continuous.
Tools have not been.

Modeling, rendering, presenting —
each stage forces a break in your thinking.
Every transition is a rebuild.
Every iteration starts from scratch.

We believe a workflow is meant to flow.
What you decide once should travel with you — to the very end.

Tools should evolve with your intent.
Not fragment it.

— The D5 Team

[ The Visualization Trilemma ][59]
[ Why we built D5 ][60]

## Three parts of one creative flow.

D5 is built as an ecosystem, not a single tool. Each part plays its role in your workflow — from
your first modeling session to your final presentation, with one intelligence learning to connect
them all.

### D5 Lite
